in_marathi.name: Sharwanami
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Vibrant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwanami हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharwanami is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharva', which refers to the Hindu God of love and fertility, Lord Shiva. The suffix 'Nami' means 'Lord of'. Thus, Sharwanami can be interpreted as 'Lord of the Vibrant', signifying the radiant and luminous qualities of the God.
